text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just to lock in a modest gain; I need to assess its risk and prospects rather than focus on my purchase price.","Repeated declines while I made no trades show that inaction is not automatically prudent; I should review my portfolio’s overall risk and whether each holding still fits my plan.","I should judge decisions by risk and expected return, not by the pain of realizing a loss or the satisfaction of realizing a gain."]}
